lines.ko: 40분간의 달 근접 비행 교신 두절까지 6분 남았습니다.
lines.en: You are six minutes from your 40-minute lunar flyby LOS.
From all of us, it's a privilege

lines.ko: 우리가 닿은 가장 먼 곳 너머로 ‘불씨’를 옮기는 여러분을 지켜볼 수 있어서요.
lines.en: to witness you carrying the fire past our farthest reach.

lines.ko: 지구에 있는 가장 중요한 신비 하나를 다시 떠올려 드리고 싶어요.
lines.en: I would like to remind you of one of the most important mysteries there on Earth,

lines.ko: 그리스도는 가장 큰 계명이 무엇이냐는 물음에
lines.en: Christ said, in response to what was the greatest command,

lines.ko: 온 존재를 다해 하나님을 사랑하는 것이라 했고,
lines.en: that it was to love God with all that you are.

lines.ko: 위대한 스승답게, 둘째도 그와 같다고 했어요.
lines.en: And he also, being a great teacher, said the second is equal to it,
and that is to love your neighbor as yourself.
And so, as we prepare to go out of radio communication,

lines.ko: 지구에서 보내는 여러분의 사랑은 계속 느낄 거예요.
lines.en: we're still going to feel your love from Earth.

lines.ko: 그리고 지구에, 또 지구 주변에 계신 모든 분들께
lines.en: And to all of you down there on Earth and around Earth,
we love you from the Moon.
Houston copies. We'll see you on the other side.
